translations.web: He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in Yahweh is blessed.
translations.bsb: Whoever heeds instruction will find success, and blessed is he who trusts in the LORD.
translations.kjv: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusteth in the LORD, happy
translations.asv: He that giveth heed unto the word shall find good; And whoso trusteth in Jehovah, happy is he.
